Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.board.Board
public class Board extends Object
Facade over the physical game board, coordinating its card rows, decks, and offer path.

The board exposes two visible card rows: the UpperPile (upper row) holds the freshly drawn tribe and building cards, while the LowerPile (lower row) holds the cards that have shifted down from the upper row and is where lower-row events are resolved. New cards are drawn from the TribeDeck and BuildingDeck.

Player placement happens on the OfferPath, which owns the offer spaces and the starting tile where players wait between turns. At the end of a round the board shifts the upper row down to the lower row and refills the upper row from the decks, detecting era changes and re-stocking building cards accordingly. It also lets callers resolve board events and look up a visible card by its id via findCardById(int).

    • setupInitialRows

      public void setupInitialRows()
      Populates the upper and lower rows with the initial set of cards drawn from the decks. Events are automatically placed in the upper row, while characters fill the lower row first.

    • returnPlayerToStartingTile

      public void returnPlayerToStartingTile(Player player)
      Moves a player from their current offer space back to the starting tile. Clears the occupied offer space and automatically places the player on the first available starting block.
      Parameters:
      player - The player who has just completed their active turn.

    • movePlayerToLastStartingTile

      public void movePlayerToLastStartingTile(Player player)

      Parameters:
      player - player to move

    • resetBoardAfterRound

      public boolean resetBoardAfterRound(Era currentEra)
      Advances the visible card rows for the next round.

      Discards the lower row's tribe cards and shifts every tribe card from the upper row down to the lower row, then refills the upper row with new tribe cards drawn from the tribe deck. Offer-path placements and the starting tile are left untouched.

      Parameters:
      currentEra - era active before resetting the board
      Returns:
      true when the refill drew a card from a new era, moving the game into it

    • getResolutionOrder

      public List<Player> getResolutionOrder()
      Retrieves the list of players currently placed on the offer path, ordered strictly ascending by their space's position index (from left to right skipping A). This method is used by the game controller to determine the exact resolution order of the active turns.
      Returns:
      A list of players sorted by their position on the offer path.

    • shiftToLastStartingTile

      public void shiftToLastStartingTile()
      Re-packs the players still on the starting tile towards its last blocks.

      Players are taken in reverse turn order and each is moved to the last free starting block, which frees up the first blocks while preserving the relative order. Landing on a block resolves its effect, so the penalty (malus) attached to the final block is applied to whoever ends up there.

    • getNextRoundTurnOrder

      public List<Player> getNextRoundTurnOrder()
      Retrieves the exact turn order for the next round. This is determined by the order in which players returned to the starting blocks.
      Returns:
      A list of players sorted by their turn order for the upcoming round.

    • resolveEventA

      public void resolveEventA()
      Checks if the offer space 'A' is currently occupied by a player. If occupied, it immediately resolves the space's specific effect for that player and returns it to the starting tile. If the space is empty or unavailable, it does nothing.

    • returnNumberDrawableCard

      public int[] returnNumberDrawableCard(Player player)
      Resolves the immediate action for the specified player based on their current offer space and retrieves their specific drafting constraints.
      Parameters:
      player - The player whose turn action is being resolved.
      Returns:
      An integer array representing the number of cards to draw, where index 0 is the amount from the upper row, and index 1 is from the lower row.

    • resolveAllEvents

      public void resolveAllEvents()
      Resolves all event cards currently present on the board (both upper and lower rows). Events are resolved in two groups: first, all regular events sorted chronologically by their Era (oldest to newest), followed by all sustenance events also sorted chronologically by their Era (oldest to newest).
